import unreal,json
from pathlib import Path
material=unreal.load_asset('/Game/Materials/MM_Landscape')
rows=[]
for obj in unreal.ObjectIterator(unreal.MaterialExpression):
 if obj.get_outermost()!=material.get_outermost(): continue
 if not any(n in obj.get_class().get_name() for n in ['BlendMaterialAttributes','MakeMaterialAttributes','LandscapeLayerBlend']): continue
 inputs=unreal.MaterialEditingLibrary.get_inputs_for_material_expression(material,obj)
 rows.append({'node':obj.get_name(),'class':obj.get_class().get_name(),'inputs':[{'name':x.get_name(),'class':x.get_class().get_name()} if x else None for x in inputs]})
Path('C:/Users/tarik/Documents/GitHub/AGP/.scratch/splatmap-v2/manual-acceptance-20261024/50-debug-color-connections.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2))
print(json.dumps(rows,indent=2))
